name: mail2mail
description: Universal Python 3.9+ email and mailbox migration toolkit (MBOX, Maildir, EML, EMLX, MSG, OLM, PST, MH, MMDF, Babyl, JMAP RFC 8620/8621, native OS file pickers, and 5-tool MCP server).
majorCapabilities: 15+ email & mailbox archive formats (MBOX, Maildir, EML, EMLX, MSG, OLM, PST, MH, MMDF, Babyl)
Hardened Outlook MAPI COM PST router with size/year/N-way volume splitting
RFC 8620/8621 JMAP client (Fastmail) & SQLite WAL incremental delta sync
Forensic SHA-256 chain-of-custody CSV/JSONL manifests & Bates stamping
5-tool JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server & native OS file/folder pickers

tools.summary: Inspect system environment, Python version, platform, Outlook COM availability, and supported formats.
Inspect magic bytes and classify mailbox format (PST, MSG, MBOX, EML, EMLX, OLM, Maildir, Thunderbird, etc.).
Convert mailbox between formats (EML, MBOX, PST) with optional deduplication and date filtering.
Forensic audit: computes cryptographic SHA-256 item hashes, Bates numbering, and CSV manifest.
Split large mailbox into volume chunks by size or year while preserving folder hierarchies.
